A few useful answers

Before we get started.

Is the calculator a final quote?

No. These are indicative ranges from our pricing framework. We confirm the scope, integrations, third-party costs, and timeline before issuing a written quote. E-commerce may exceed the displayed range.

What if my project changes?

Material scope changes are agreed in writing with a revised estimate before additional work begins. Custom development is separately scoped.

Are hosting and a domain included?

They are quoted separately from the website build. Hosting is included in the optional care plans. Domain registration and paid tools are additional.

How long will the project take?

We agree a timeline after discovery, based on scope, content readiness, review turnaround, and availability. Rush delivery is subject to confirmation.
